THE BLOCK IS THE KHANNA 2025 FINDING — 'Supported by a 2025 systematic review of topical glutathione', concluding measurable benefits for the appearance of skin tone and favourable safety and tolerability across the reviewed topical trials.

WHY THIS SLOT IS THE SHARPEST TEST IN THE BATCH. Slot d cast a densely freckled woman deliberately, because a brightening page is exactly where an engine wants to clear discrete marks away, and this is the frame where that either holds or does not. VERIFIED AT 100%, NOT FROM THE CONTACT SHEET: every freckle and sun spot present in the left panel is still present in the right, in the same places and countable, while the muddy blotchy field BETWEEN them has calmed and the low-cheek redness has settled. Pores and fine surface texture survive in both panels — no smoothing. That is the distinction the whole r2 brief was rewritten to protect, and it is intact here.

⚠️ MEASURED, AND THE NUMBER DOES NOT SAY WHAT THE PICTURE SAYS. Sampling skin-like pixels only (R>G>B, mid-bright — which excludes wall, hair and garment, so a whole-panel mean is meaningless here): mean luminance 132.1 left against 164.7 right, so the after panel is +32.6 BRIGHTER; and the spread of tone across the skin, which is what 'more even' actually claims, is 29.36 left against 30.76 right — about 5% WIDER, not narrower. Read literally that is 'she is better lit', not 'her tone is more even'. Two reasons not to treat it as a verdict either: the two panels are deliberately different rooms with different walls and garments, so exposure is confounded by design; and the crops frame slightly different anatomy, so the two SDs are not measuring the same skin. It is recorded because a number checked only against itself gets believed on this project, and because the honest position is that the visual freckle-retention claim is solid while the evenness claim is not independently evidenced by measurement. Malcolm chose the frame with the alternates on screen.

⚠️ BRIEFED AT f1's MAGNITUDE, NOT f3's. Slot d belongs to the f1 family (Watanabe 2014, 2% GSSG, ten weeks, melanin index p < 0.001), whose brief licenses a clearly visible change. f3's own slots were capped at 'real but modest', because a pooled review conclusion carries no percentage and an emphatic before/after overstates it — the same reasoning that capped acetyl's f3. Recorded, not re-litigated.

NO LABELS ON THIS BLOCK, AND IT IS A REAL GAP. media-with-text has no caption, overlay, label or badge setting — every setting on both of its block types was checked on 2026-08-27. The sibling research pages carry their diptychs in the custom `research-before-after` section, which renders Before / After / a result line as DOM TEXT over the image, translatable through Translate & Adapt. Here a visitor sees two photographs of the same woman with nothing telling them which is which. Raised with Malcolm; not actioned, because he asked for an image replacement and moving a block between sections is a structural change to his page.

SQUARE, 1:1, NON-NEGOTIABLE — media-with-text has no aspect-ratio on the media div and the row height comes from the master's own aspect, so a non-square file would make this block taller than f1 and f2. The row is also sized by the copy, so a long text column cover-crops a square master slightly at the edges; measured on the live page after publishing rather than assumed. The split sits at 49.66% of width, near enough centre that the research-before-after labels would land correctly if that section is ever adopted here.

OPTIMISED, NOT COMPRESSED, AND THIS IS WHERE THE EARLIER ATTEMPT WENT WRONG. The uploader's optimise() used to judge 'already web-ready' on dimensions and metadata alone and never looked at the FORMAT, so a PNG straight out of a generation run was uploaded as a PNG. Measured off this store's CDN: the PNG source delivered 166,464B of WebP at w1000 against the 45,490B a JPEG source gives, and 1,591,711B of raw PNG to any client not sending Accept: image/webp — roughly 3.7x and 35x. Fixed in scripts/upload-theme-images.py; a non-JPEG source is now always re-encoded, once, at quality 95 4:4:4 with metadata stripped.

NEW FILENAME, NEVER A RE-UPLOAD: Shopify Files suffixes a name collision and keeps serving the original. This stem shares nothing but 'skingenetix-glutathione-' with the orphaned slot-c files, so the uploader's prefix poll cannot bind the wrong one.
